selected_engine.purpose: Separately built candidate; run catalog, pregame and interaction checks before activation

findings: Unmodified candidate misses 12 open-opponent ground attacks (two creatures, three AI modes, original/copied state). All-open and flying positive controls and sick/tapped/defender negative controls pass.

Eight explicit native combat outcomes pass: Goreclaw attack trigger grants power five/trample and deals five damage; Grizzly Bears deals two; holding deals zero. This verifies controlled outcomes, not autonomous choice.
Six additional legal group-attack opportunities are missed by baseline. Mandatory attacks, optional unpayable taxes, global attack prohibition and hopeless blocked-board controls pass.

Both generic reconsideration prototypes recover the opportunities. Both expose six unsafe counterattack declarations. v2 reuses existing blocker reservation, which evaluates opponents independently rather than accumulating successive combats.

Four actual sequential native counterattack outcomes establish the corrected safety premise: holding Goreclaw against two nontrampling Craw Wurms survives at one life; attacking leads to elimination at minus five life. Results hold in original/copied state.
fixture_corrections: Initial all-open control incorrectly required one particular equally open opponent; corrected only that arbitrary seat requirement in v2, preserving its original 33/17 report.

Initial guard control used trampling Colossal Dreadmaws, so holding a three-toughness blocker was not sufficient to establish survival. Corrected only guard attackers to nontrampling Craw Wurms and added four actual native outcomes. Preserve all original 36-case phases; do not cite their guard results as survival proof.

Driver setup had a prototype filename typo. Baseline finished once; the attempted prototype command reported missing file before execution. Corrected prototype ran once in a fresh phase after that terminal shell result.
next_requirements: Evaluate cumulative native counterattacks before the actor next untaps, including surviving blockers, deaths, damage and decision beneficiary.
Retain legality, taxes, mandatory/group declarations, copied-state isolation, normal native trigger/damage resolution, timeout and random-provider restoration controls.
Do not force named-card attacks, change fixed full-game seeds, retry for a favorable witness or weaken existing conformance checks.
Run source, sealed-build, packaged, broader and full-live gates before activating any correction.
limits: Partial supplied boards do not certify universally optimal multiplayer strategy, full decks or full card rules support.
No production source, build recipe, selected engine lock, card script or AI profile was changed.
Rejected patch files are preserved review artifacts and are not selected by a build recipe.
Native TestNG failures are preserved even though the diagnostic worker process exits normally after writing its report.
